svg.title: TX and RX finite state machines
svg.desc: Two animated state-machine lanes. The transmitter walks IDLE, START, DATA, optional PARITY, STOP and optional STOP2. The receiver does the same plus a BREAK state reachable from any state via a free-running low-run counter.
svg.text: TX / RX STATE MACHINES · runtime parity + stop-bit config latched once per frame
frame done → tx_done pulse (S_STOP if 1 stop bit, else S_STOP2)
center-sampled stop → rx_valid / pe / fe pulses
break_detected (free-running low-run counter, independent of the FSM)
S_START → S_IDLE on a false start (line high at half-bit) · break threshold is sized for the longest frame the RX can be configured for
Both engines are 4–6 state FSMs depending on the latched parity / stop-bit configuration.
